description: This source file defines a public enumeration 'BonjourEscapes' with a static method 'decode' that processes strings containing mDNS/DNS-SD escape sequences (e.g., '\032' for space) and returns the unescaped string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a string containing escape sequences of the form '\DDD' where DDD is a decimal byte value, translating them into their corresponding characters and returning the unescaped string.
